### Highlights

- **Welcome splash shows the version.** The line above the logo names Velta, the Chatmail core, and either Tauri or the PWA service-worker cache.
- **Grey identity tiles.** A contact with no key yet, and your own profile before it has an address, keep the fingerprint pattern in greyscale until a real key is there.
- **PWA keeps the account database.** A refresh no longer drops the signed-in profile. A new deploy reaches an open page on the next load; a page that was already open shows an update notice.
- **DNS tunnel.** Automatic mode stays on the direct route when the relays are down, not blocked. The tunnel uses soar 0.2.0.
